newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexicans prepare suit against Abaco chairman-paper.
newsitem.headline: Mexicans prepare suit against Abaco chairman-paper.

text.p: Four Mexican businessmen are preparing a suit against the chairman of Grupo Financiero Abaco for offshore investments made via the financial company, the daily Reforma reported in Thursday editions.

Reforma, citing unnamed sources close to the process, said the businessmen from the northern city of Monterrey are to file suit against Jorge Lankenau Rocha because they are in disagreement over interest and capital payments stemming from the offshore investments in Uruguay.
Abaco could not be reached for comment early this morning.
Reforma said the businessmen, who were not named, had not yet decided if it would be a civil or criminal suit against Lankenau.

Citicorp's Citibank is tipped as the likely winner in an ongoing process to buy Abaco, which needs a cash injection of around $250 million to comply with capitalization levels in the Mexican banking system.
